outcome: Maximum diameter of the gestational sac
Distribution of the villous chorion sites
Main blood supply sites of the gestational sac
Surgical bleeding volume during termination of gestation
cohort: 38 pregnant women with a gestational sac located in the lower uterine segment with a history of cesarean section
finding: Patients with CSPs and other LUSPs have different imaging characteristics on ultrasound, particularly thinner lower uterine myometrium, larger gestational sac diameter, and different villous chorion and blood supply sites.
